name: Thakral Services (India) Limited
about: Thakral Services (India) Limited provides electronic security solutions, including CCTV, access control, fire detection, alarms, and intrusion alarms in India. The company offers surveillance systems, which comprise analog cameras, such as dome, box, speed dome, infra-red, and pinhole cameras, as well as digital video recorders. It also offers fire alarm systems, as well as its components, such as control panels, initiators, and indicating/notifying appliances; intrusion alarm systems and system components; and access control panels and system components, as well as time and attendance, and visitor management software products. In addition, the company provides grid-tied solar systems, building management systems, and accessories. The company serves clients in the banking and finance, information technology, healthcare, education, retail, media, utilities, and hospitality industries. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Primeast Investments Limited and changed its name to Thakral Services (India) Limited in February 2007. Thakral Services (India) Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India. Thakral Services (India) Limited operates as a subsidiary of Netizen Properties Pvt Ltd.
